change: Add a namespaced object containing deterministic module envelopes. Keep every existing field and its semantics unchanged.
required_reviews: Android reference behavior in cursorfu where relevant

reader_contract.old_producer_new_reader: A reader that understands analysis_extensions may validate and display the deterministic envelope without changing base findings.
reader_contract.new_producer_old_reader: An older reader ignores the unknown optional extension and continues to read every 1.11.0 field.
reader_contract.round_trip: A reader that rewrites the package preserves unknown extension names and values byte-faithfully after canonical serialization.
reader_contract.unknown_module: Unknown module names are preserved and ignored, never treated as a failed package or a sealed finding.
reader_contract.geometry: Geometry remains optional; its absence never removes an exact text quote and page anchor.
reader_contract.duplicates: Readers do not silently deduplicate findings; canonical sorting is stable and retains equal records.

production_gate: Do not add analysis_extensions to buildFindingsJson or change findings_json_version until coordinated cross-client approval is recorded.
